page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.2xlarge offers a memory-optimized profile suitable for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity. The absence of local storage and integrated GPUs positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for memory-intensive tasks that do not require high-performance local disk I/O or hardware acceleration. Appropriate workloads include small-scale databases, caching layers, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and lightweight data processing tasks.
